name: Colorado Trail Day 12: Monarch Pass to Sargents Mesa
gear: New Balance Hierro v8  Shadow Grey
description: Had a panic attack in Salida that turned into a full brown menty B that lasted all the way until I managed to get myself back on the trail. Had a good 6 mile cry now on to Lake City. Taking life one day at a time for as long as it takes. Salida is a lovely town but not great for resupply logistically. Hitched up with a great guy who's name I can't remember unfortunately but he's a firefighter in Salida and was literally driving to his Monarch resort patrol interview. Lost my ID somewhere. Had trouble finding a campsite so it was a late night. Fell asleep to some light freezing rain and dramatic lightning not far off. Getting cold! Finally starting to catch up to the tail end of most through hikers.
